134.news_title: Custom 15khz Large Arcade Monitors including 43inch and 55inch now Available
134.long_description: Our new range of our custom 15khz, 25khz, 31khz up to 1080p arcade 43 and 55inch LCD monitors are now available and offers arcade owners to upgrade their older screens to current series LCD panels. Great to replace the older rear projection arcade monitors, or, to update broken arcade LCD panels. The latest version firmware V32 now offers; - a wider range of 15khz arcade game board titles supported including 50,54 60 and 70Hz titles such as NBA Jam / Mortal Kombat, supports 24khz game titles such as Daytona USA & Virtua Striker, and all 31khz titles up to 1080P. - quicker video resolution locking; - offers 7 menu languages, updated auto picture functions, quicker transition between video signal resolutions, and more. The new arcade LCD monitors also offer a wide range of mounting options as well as audio out for HDMI users. 43inch Arcooda Custom Arcade LCD Monitor 55inch Arcooda Custom Arcade LCD Monitor
